scope: Exploratory development-only full-pool union of Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B and Ministral-3-8B
evidence_source: User-pasted console output from summarize_expansion_dpo_coverage.py --combine-models on Gadi
coverage: A question is covered if at least one candidate from any of the three models is officially accepted; no combined ranking is evaluated
interpretation: Ten-draw combined DPO coverage is 123/160 versus 121/160 for SFT: two gains and no losses, an increase of 1.25 percentage points
Both new union questions are Qwen gains; the other Qwen gain and both Ministral gains were already covered by the SFT union
The greedy union remains at 101/160 with zero gains and losses; both individual Llama gains were already covered by another SFT model
The sampled union coverage interval includes zero and McNemar p=0.5: the small observed benefit is not statistically conclusive
Combined coverage is an oracle availability measure; it does not establish combined MRR@5 or an improvement in scientific correctness
limitations: One training seed on a reused development set; exploratory unadjusted p-values
Full-pool union can contain up to 300 candidate slots from 30 requests; it is not an official submission or a fixed ten-candidate evaluation
Source hashes and gained/lost question IDs are in the Gadi JSON, not the pasted console output
